title: 鱼在水里怎么呼吸
subtitle: 水里也有氧气
character: wearing a teal t-shirt, dark blue shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, bright gouache painting on textured paper, flat simple rounded shapes with clean outlines, few details, fresh sea green and sandy palette, soft visible brush texture

pages.zh:
我把脸埋进水里，
憋了三秒就憋不住了。
可是鱼一辈子都待在水里，
它们是怎么呼吸的呢？
pages.scene: The little boy kneels beside a small pond or basin, his face just above the water, cheeks puffed as if holding his breath.

pages.zh:
我们呼吸，
是把空气吸进肺里，
把里面的氧气留下来。
没有氧气，
人一会儿也活不了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple pair of lungs on a pale background with one arrow going in and one arrow going out. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水里没有空气，
可是水里溶着氧气。
就像糖化在水里看不见一样，
氧气也化在水里，
鱼要的就是它。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one glass of water on a pale background with many tiny round bubbles drawn evenly inside the water. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鱼的身体两侧，
有一道一道的缝，
那是「鳃」。
鳃盖一张一合，
水就从嘴巴进、从鳃出去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one fish seen from the side on a pale background with its gill cover drawn clearly, one arrow entering at the mouth and one arrow leaving at the gill. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鳃里面是一排排红红的鳃丝，
又薄又软，
上面全是细细的血管。
水从中间流过，
氧气就被血管接住了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one gill arch on a pale background with a row of thin red filaments on it, shown large and simple. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鳃丝为什么要那么多层呢？
因为层数越多，
碰到水的面积就越大，
能接住的氧气也就越多。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two shapes side by side on a pale background: on the left one flat plate, on the right the same plate folded into many thin layers, the folded one clearly larger in surface. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以鱼一直在喝水，
又一直从鳃把水吐出去。
它不是在喝个不停，
它是在呼吸。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one fish on a pale background with a dotted line showing water entering the mouth, passing over the gills and leaving behind the gill cover. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
把鱼捞出水面，
它反而会闷死。
因为在空气里，
鳃丝会黏在一起塌下来，
碰不到空气了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two gill filaments side by side on a pale background: the left one spread open in water, the right one collapsed and stuck together in air. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水里的氧气有多有少。
水凉、水流动的地方氧气多；
水热、不流动的地方氧气少，
鱼就会浮到水面，
一张一合地换气。
pages.scene: A simple scene on a pale background: on one side a cool stream with fish swimming low, on the other side a still warm pond with fish near the surface, mouths open. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有的鱼还有别的办法。
泥鳅会吞一口空气，
用肠子吸收氧气；
弹涂鱼干脆爬上岸，
把水含在鳃里慢慢用。
pages.scene: Two simple pictures side by side on a pale background: a loach at the water surface taking a gulp of air, and a mudskipper sitting on wet mud beside the water. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
鲸鱼看起来像鱼，
其实不是。
它没有鳃，
要浮到水面用鼻孔呼吸，
喷出一股白白的水汽。
pages.scene: One whale at the sea surface on a pale background with a spout of white mist rising from the blowhole on top of its head. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我在鱼缸前趴了好久，
看那条小金鱼的鳃盖
一张一合，一张一合。
它不是在喝水，
它是在呼吸。
pages.scene: The little boy leans close to a round fish tank, watching one orange goldfish inside, his face lit by the water.
